title: The Share of a Grant Period an Employee Is Treated as Available For
content:
On the plans that prorate employer allowance for recorded leave, the share of a grant period an Employee Meal Account is treated as available for is read from the leaves of absence standing on the account's request log. The long leave share is 45 percent and the part month share is 70 percent.

**Clause.** Where the plan prorates allowance for recorded leave and two or more leaves of absence stand on the account's request log from the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked, the availability share is the long leave share. Where the plan prorates allowance for recorded leave and exactly one leave of absence stands on that log from the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked, the availability share is the part month share. Where neither holds, the availability share is the whole of the grant period.

## Which plans prorate allowance for leave

| Meal plan | Allowance prorated for part months of leave |
|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | no |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | no |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | no |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | yes |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | yes |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | yes |

## The bands

| Plan prorates allowance for leave | Leaves of absence on the request log from the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked | Availability share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 2 or more | 45 percent |
| Yes | Exactly 1 | 70 percent |
| Yes | None | The whole of the grant period |
| No | Any number | The whole of the grant period |

What is counted is leave of absence entries on the account's own request log, over the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked, whatever length of leave each records.

*Hypothetical illustration.* On a plan that prorates, an account carrying two recorded leaves in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked is treated as available for 45 percent of the grant period, so a base grant of $20.00 is taken down to $9.00 at that step; carrying one, it is treated as available for 70 percent and the same base grant becomes $14.00.
